facts.text: Riverdale Park was founded on March 23, 1889 when Fox and Lutz formed the Riverdale Park Company, naming the town after a grand Federal‑style mansion.
By the early 1900s the town boasted 60 homes, a Presbyterian church, a schoolhouse, and a railroad station, making it a bustling community.
The town’s name was officially changed to Riverdale Park in 1998, dropping the extra “s” that once appeared in the historic plantation’s name.
Riverdale Park’s roots trace back to a 1801 plantation, where the original Riversdale house was built and later became a museum celebrating local history.
Founded in 1920, the town’s modern community center now hosts events like summer concerts and free memorial tours for residents and visitors alike.
